meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把一个 DAG 图定义存成带名字的 JSON 文件，之后用名字即可重新运行，不必每次粘贴完整定义。运行时会自动替换占位符并按需加时间戳后缀，保证每次是新运行或可幂等复用。
howto.when: 当用户想保存一个 DAG、运行已经保存的 DAG，或反复调度同一个多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 把当前这个 DAG 存成名字叫 nightly-audit。
say.note: 会写文件并试运行一次确认。
会生成带新时间戳的 key，开启新运行。

say.text: 按名字跑 nightly-audit，指定后缀 20260818。
say.note: 相同 key 可复用之前结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can store a DAG graph definition as a named JSON file and re-run it later by name, without pasting the full definition every time. At load, placeholders and key suffixes are applied so each run is fresh or idempotent as needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save a DAG, run an already-saved DAG, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent graph.

say_en.note: Writes the file and does a trial run to confirm.
Creates a key with a fresh timestamp for a new run.
Same key reuses the previous result.
